supported_claims: Finite n=3, discrete 3x3 grid, nine frozen functions, IID vs LHS source distributions and estimator moments exactly verified.
Three additive worlds have exactly zero LHS variance.
Three nonadditive worlds have 3/2 LHS to IID variance ratio under exactly equal function evaluation budgets.
limitations: No randomized execution or original McKay/Stein software or data reproduction.
Only discrete 3x3 complete no-jitter finite experiment; no general continuous or high-dimensional LHS superiority claim.
No human or historical observations or model fusion.
